questions: Q1: What CLI files need PLAY updates?
Q2: Does EXECUTE get removed or does PLAY coexist?
Q3: What deployment ordering is required?

answers.answer: Three files: (1) src/tickets/create.ts — VALID_MODES array line 13, help text line 17; (2) src/tickets/index.ts — usage text line 21, help text line 73; (3) src/docs/cli-content.ts — mode table line 109, example line 247, description line 250. Skill docs (skill-content/SKILL.md, skill-content/references/commands.md) also reference modes.
evidence: Previous diagnosis: index.ts:21,73 and cli-content.ts:109,247,250 also reference EXECUTE

answers.answer: EXECUTE is replaced by PLAY. Zero production usage. Ticket says 'replaces execute'. No backward compatibility needed.

Server deploys first. CLI sends mode to POST /api/tickets — server validates against platformConfig.allowedModes. If CLI sends PLAY before server recognizes it, server returns 400. Coordinate deployment.
evidence: create.ts:147 — mode sent in POST body

statement: CLI is the smallest change surface: replace EXECUTE with PLAY in VALID_MODES, help text, and docs across 3-5 files. Server must deploy first. Only MVP-1 touches the CLI.
